notes: Card charges no longer create a duplicate donor row when the charge carries only a name: the charge now attaches to the caller's selected donor or the pledge's own donor
release_notes: PR #368: cardknox-charge now uses the caller's donor id (verified to the org) or the pledge's own donor before falling back to phone/email matching, so a pledge charge can never mint a duplicate donor. ChargeOrScheduleDialog sends donor_id.
